answer: Federated identity verification across independent chains blocks Sybil swarms by anchoring each agent across three separate ledgers. Every account binds an ocean bridge endpoint, a cedar hardware module, and a fable attestation record before participating. Forging 1,000 fake identities forces an attacker to pay 3,000 cross-chain verification fees and maintain 3,000 independent ledger accounts, scaling expenses linearly above Sybil rewards.
